Some frequently asked questions are:

Q: Will I receive the item shown in the photo? Is the photo of the exact card that will be sent?
A: Yes! every item is photographed individually so buyers can see the exact copy before they purchase the item. For listings where it shows multiple copies have sold already, rest assured after each sale we update the photo to show the next copy that is being sold.

Q: How long does shipping take?
A: Items are packaged and shipped 4 or 5 days a week, so the time for us to get your purchase into the mail is really fast. That being said, our shipping location is in western Canada, on Vancouver Island, so buyers in eastern Canada are going to have longer waits than central or western buyers. Typically items arrive in under two weeks, with orders often arriving in one week or less. eBays system may say the order will arrive faster than what our experience has shown, so please plan on the item taking 1-2 weeks to arrive after purchasing it. For international buyers I can not provide an accurate estimate on shipment wait times, but tracking will be made available from the eBay Global Shipping Program 1-2 weeks after the purchase, and delivery perhaps 1-3 weeks after that.

Q: Will you take $x for your card? What is your lowest price?
A: Generally I do not negotiate below my listed price unless there are sellers with the same item for less; I will always price match items. I will not respond to offers that are more than 10% off my listed price, unless you are providing a screenshot of a listing you want me to price match. I will only price match the lowest active listings, sold listings will not be matched 100% of the time. I may enable offers on items if you message me looking for a small discount. If you send me photos of your collection and it relates to an expensive item I am selling I am more excited to help than if you are just trying to resell my items.

Q: How will you package the order?
A: This is complicated, as price, size and location all influence how an order is packaged, because we have to balance shipment costs with the goal of keeping item prices as low as possible. If you order 1-2 cards under a $35 total, you are located in Canada, the cards will be put into a top-loader with masking tape sealing the opening, then put in an envelope. If you order 3-6 cards under a $35 total, you are located in Canada, the cards will be put into a Card saver I (semi-rigid holder), then put in an envelope. For 1-6 card orders over $35 the cards will be put into top-loaders and the tops taped closed, then put into a bubble mailer. If you order 7+ cards they will be put into a team baggy, with top-loaders taped onto either side of the outside of the bag, for protection, then put into a bubble mailer.
Side note - After well over 20,000 items shipped this way only 2 have arrived damaged due to transit, and the buyers were taken care of completely. I understand if people have had different experiences with shipments, our method has been successful anyway.


Thank you for reading my answers! If you have other questions please reach out and I will help you! Please think of reaching out if you are considering selling off old bulk cards too!!!

Pokemon Singles, Graded Cards, Sealed Products and More

Card Condition

Please, read the condition of the card in the title of the listing (NM, LP, MP, HP)

You will receive a card of equal or greater condition of what is listed! Cards will range from Near Mint (NM) to Heavily Played (HP), and the price always reflects the condition. If you have questions about the item, please send us a message to avoid any conflicts! Please see our condition guide below.

Near Mint (NM) = A Near Mint card is a card that may have very minor imperfections such as nicks on edges or light scratches. Many times, NM cards that we have in stock are actually in better than NM condition however we mark them as NM to be conservative in our grading.

Lightly Played (LP) = A Lighty Played card is a card that has a few minor imperfections such as nicks, minor scuffing, edge wear and/or light scratches.

Moderately Played (MP) = A Moderately Played card is a card that has noticeable play wear including edge wear, nicks, scratches, a minor bend or scuffs.

Heavily Played (HP) = A Heavily Played card is a card that has been damaged and may include heavy wear, creases, dents, scratches, bends, scuffs, inking, water damage and/or other types of damage.

Shipping

We offer combined shipping! Simply add everything you'd like to your cart, and then click 'Go to checkout'. A shipping discount will apply automatically.

Good news! All items will be shipped within one business day to get them into your hands as fast as we can!

We ship all over the world including Canada, United States, Europe, United Kingdom, Australia, China, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, Taiwan, Middle East, Mexico, Brazil & More! Simply add your items into your cart and click 'Go to checkout' once you've finished adding your items.

Note for U.S. buyers: There are no additional tariffs or customs fees on this item, as it is fully compliant under the CUSMA (CANADA-U.S.-Mexico) trade agreement.

At times, the suggested delivery estimates provided by eBay are not always accurate. Many factors may contribute to delays in delivering the package such as weather, time of year, location and customs (if applicable).

We thank you for your patience!

Returns

Returns are accepted within thirty days of purchase. We want to make this right for you!

We welcome you to contact us if you have further questions about this item.

Prior to purchasing, please review the condition chart prior to purchase to ensure this item meets your expectations!

Feedback

We will always leave positive feedback for you! We ask if you can do the same for us!

If there is any reason why the transaction was not up to your expectations, please message us before leaving feedback so we can address the issue.

Looking for more Pokemon singles? Visit our store to see our full selection.

To my eye, this card is in near mint (NM) condition.  The front of the card is in spectacular shape; a few minor edgewear spots on the back are the only instances of meaningful wear.  Please review the listing photos and make your own determination.  For additional details about the item, please send me a message and I'll get back to you as soon as I am able.  I'm happy to provide more photos upon request.

The dense cosmos holo—including, particularly, the massive, prominent swirl—make this one of the most breathtakingly beautiful Pokémon cards I have ever had the pleasure of owning.  I hate to rehome it, but my loss is your gain; this card will make a one-of-a-kind addition to any serious collection.

Barring unforeseen circumstances, the item will be shipped within five business days of purchase.  Unless otherwise noted, your purchase will be shipped in a soft sleeve and toploader within a lightly reinforced plain white envelope (or a padded mailer for expensive purchases).  If this shipping method is not agreeable to you, please message me prior to purchase.  If you have any questions or problems with the item, please message me before leaving negative feedback and I will try to work it out with you!  As my feedback indicates, buyer satisfaction is my top priority.  (And, on that note, please leave me positive feedback upon receipt of your item!)

For items over $20 but under $35, I’ll occasionally ship PWE (Plain White Envelope) to save on ever-more-egregious shipping costs.  Not paying $6 to ship a $21 card lol.  You won’t get a tracking number, so I’m counting on you to be a decent person in this case and be honest that you received the card.  If this method is disagreeable, let me know and I’ll occasionally make an exception.
  4. Almost every item I sell has a shipping and handing window of (5) business days, as conveyed multiple times throughout the listing.  If you need urgent shipping, I’m probably not a good bet.  Messages hassling me about when your order will ship will be ignored, UNLESS the card is for a special event (birthday gift, e.g.) in which case I will do my best to expedite the shipping. 
  5. If you are (1) an international buyer or (2) buying a card for over $250, your item will be shipped to an eBay Global Shipping Program or an eBay authenticator, respectively.  Once the item is in the hands of the eBay GSP hub or the authenticator, it is 100% out of my hands.  After the GSP or authenticator's receipt of the item, liability shifts to them and there's nothing I can do to help you.  Any communications surrounding shipping past that point (e.g. “it’s been sitting with the authenticator for days” or “I never received my item”) should be directed to eBay.
  6. By and large, I do not accept cancellation requests submitted more than a few hours after sale.  “Accidentally bought this,” “didn’t notice X,” “misread the listing,” “didn’t notice the S&H time,” etc. are unacceptable reasons to cancel, by and large.  It’s on you to read the listing and look at the photos before you click “Buy it Now,” and I lose potential by not having an item listed for days.
  7. I am not a harsh or unreasonable guy, and I understand that extenuating circumstances come up.  A sudden medical emergency is good reason to request a cancellation.  Lack of reading comprehension is not.

Condition classification methodology and disclaimer:

How do I come up with card conditions, and what do they mean?


MINT:  Pack fresh.  I use this designation VERY rarely; typically limited to cards I recently pulled myself.  If graded, I would expect a 9 or 10.**


NM+ (strong near mint):  The higher end of “near mint;” indicates a card that, while imperfect, is still quite clean.  Wear is likely limited to a couple dots of very minor edgewear and/or some barely discernible hairline scratching on the foil, as applicable.  The card would look effectively mint in a sleeve or binder.  If graded, I would expect an 8 or—VERY rarely—a 9 on a really good day.**


NM (near mint):  The card has very slight wear, typically a small amount of edgewear or holo scratching.  “NEAR MINT” DOES NOT MEAN “MINT.”  DO NOT BUY A NEAR MINT CARD EXPECTING A PSA 9-10 CANDIDATE.  If graded, I would expect a 7 (perhaps an 8 if your grader is in a cheery mood).**


VLP (very lightly played):  Similar to NM, but the wear is slightly more pronounced.  Sometimes, VLP or VLP-NM indicates a card with a near-immaculate front but mild-to-moderate edgewear on the back, or similar.  If graded, I would expect a 6—maybe a 7 if your grader is in a cheery mood.**


LP (lightly played):  The card has discernible moderate-to-mild wear, usually in multiple places (e.g., edgewear and slight holo scratching), but no significant damage such as creasing, water damage, defacement, etc.  LP cards typically look great in a sleeve or binder.  If graded, I would expect a 6—maybe a 7 if your grader is feeling generous, maybe a 5 if your grader is having a REALLY bad day.**


MP (moderately played):  The card has significant, easily visible wear, but that wear is generally still limited to things like edgewear, scratching, scuffing, etc.  I occasionally categorize cards that have a very tiny crease or a slightly bent corner as MP, but only if the rest of the card would otherwise be NM or VLP.  If graded, I would expect a 4, 5, or 6.**


HP / DMG (heavily played / damaged):  I use these interchangeably for cards that are straight-up beat: large creases, multiple smaller creases, very severe edgewear, writing, deep surface indents, water damage, etc.  If graded, I would expect a 1, 2, 3, or maaaaybe 4.**


** I do not guarantee any particular grade in any capacity, and accept no liability/refunds/returns if you purchase an item expecting a certain grade and do not receive it.  PSA (and every other grading service) is imprecise, inconsistent, and fickle.  These are simply my best guesses based on hundreds cards personally graded through PSA over the past six years.


Additional General Disclaimer:  I do my best to provide an accurate representation of the item's condition, but I am not an expert and do not guarantee any particular PSA grade, nor do I claim that my estimations of "near mint," etc. correspond precisely with those of PSA or other grading services.  Generally speaking (unless the card is literally pack fresh), the highest condition estimation I will give a card is "strong near mint" or "NM+," which means I would expect the card to grade a PSA 8 or better.


If you are an international buyer purchasing multiple items, eBay will not combine your shipping (as I ship through the Global Shipping Program).  Please message me either prior to purchase or prior to payment and we will work through a solution.


Thanks for looking, and make sure to check out my other listings!  Happy buying!

Lightly Played (LP) - Cards with this grade may have a few dings, light playwear and/or edgewear. A crease or bend is acceptable if it is less than approximately 1/2 inch in size and is only visible on one side.

Moderately Played (MP) - Cards with this grade may have dings, playwear and/or edgewear, 1 or 2 creases or bends that do not go through the length of the card.
